scope: Offline CPU production modules at 20 Hz controller update and 120 Hz fixed physics. No browser/GPU/rendering or human playtest claim.

assumptions.driver: Deterministic clean bridge-aware controller, not fastest possible or human-play timing. Holds/releases ordinary pedal only; requests about 4 m/s near narrow bridges and future unsuitable terrain; no steering/pose/fuel injection.
assumptions.refills: Free and instantaneous when the actual vehicle centre enters each prior right-hand 4.4 m fuel circle; every prior station required by the harness. No dwell time added. Successful delivery to the left-hand circle instantly pays and returns to hangar.
assumptions.restart: Driving-only timing excludes garage walking, cooldown, car purchase, menus and reload. Cash/min shown separately with assumed 0, 5, 10 and 20 seconds of restart overhead per run. Those overheads are sensitivities, not measurements.
assumptions.upgrades: Stock means all levels 0; max10 means all four stats level 10 already owned. Does not charge time or brains to buy upgrades, and does not assert an optimal purchase plan.
assumptions.failures: All reported successful rates assume no missed refills, collision or bridge fall. Real learning and mistakes are unmeasured. Late failed runs pay zero, so real long-route yield can be substantially lower.
assumptions.reward: One endpoint payout per run, not cumulative station rewards. No skill bonuses exist in this baseline. Driving brains measured through production tickProgress are separate from delivery money.
